text:
maya: heads-up: our PRs are getting noisy again — full eval matrix is running on every PR and killing runners :grimacing:
omar: ugh, saw that. some quant+full-bench combos take ~45m each, matrix x3 per PR is brutal
jun: agreed. we had the smoke-vs-full split before, did the GH workflow change?
maya: someone extended the matrix to include modes: [smoke, full, quant-full] and we forgot the PR conditional. wanted to share a quick patch idea
jun: can we gate full and quant-full to non-pr events? nightly + manual only? that'd keep PRs fast
tayla: +1. devs keep pushing tiny stubs and waiting for 2h checks. kills iteration speed :/
omar: quick fix patch (untested):
```
name: evals
on:
  pull_request:
    types: [opened, synchronize]
  schedule:
    - cron: '0 5 * * *' # nightly full
jobs:
  run:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    strategy:
      matrix:
        mode: [smoke]
    steps:
      - run: ./scripts/run-eval --mode ${{ matrix.mode }}
```

# then separate workflow for full/quant with `on: schedule` and `workflow_dispatch` only
kevin: that looks fine. we should also add a small smoke that runs a cached artifact check so PRs still catch obvious regressions
jun: + add a label-based bypass? e.g., if PR has label `run-full-eval` then allow full on PRs for opt-in
maya: yes — simplest: for full workflow use `if: github.event_name != 'pull_request' || contains(github.event.pull_request.labels.*.name, 'run-full-eval')`
ci-bot: gha: workflow 'evals-full' queued by schedule (nightly)
omar: another problem: self-hosted runner pool sometimes drops during quant jobs because of CUDA mismatch — need to mark quant jobs with `runs-on: [self-hosted, gpu-quant]` so they don't land on general GPU hosts
kevin: can we instead run quant-only on Dedicated infra via Buildkite? Buildkite has more stable GPU tagging there
jun: happy to move quant to BK. GH actions remains for smoke + small benchmarks. BK pipeline triggers on `push` to main and nightly for full matrix
maya: plan: 1) patch GH workflows to smoke-only on PRs + opt-in label 2) create BK pipeline for quant/full that runs on push/main + nightly 3) add a smoke artifact sanity check for PRs 4) update docs in devex repo
tayla: timeline? I can own 1 and 3 today
omar: i'll prototype BK pipeline for quant tomorrow, will ping infra for runner tags
jun: I'll add the label-aware condition and a short doc blurb for maintainers
kevin: once landed, let's add a rollout: start allowing a small % of forks to run full for a day to catch infra surprises
maya: nice — thanks team. saving dev cycles = big win :tada:
ci-bot: gha: workflow 'evals-smoke' completed: success
kevin: post-merge follow-up: add a dashboard card showing avg PR eval time so we can monitor regressions
maya: adding to observability backlog. closing thread after patches land
